Value: Compute aspect from G09 CLEAN DEM using GDAL gdaldem aspect OR QGIS raster terrain analysis. Convention: 0/360 = North; 90 = East; 180 = South; 270 = West. Flat areas assigned -1 or 9999 (nodata) — document which convention is used. Algorithm: Horn (1981) consistent with G10 slope.
G24 (flood hazard — aspect used for solar-driven drying/wetting), G27 (erosion aspect analysis)

Aspect is used primarily for terrain characterisation and as an input to solar radiation / evapotranspiration estimates. In the Nigeria study context aspect-driven moisture differences are secondary to slope and flow accumulation for hazard modelling. Convention for flat areas (-1 vs 9999) must be consistent and documented.
